run_merge_web_docs_texts: run the script to merge line-deduplicated texts into the web document dataset by job index
download_dataset_from_s3: download a HuggingFace dataset shard from S3 using aws s3 sync and load_from_disk
replace_dataset_column: replace the texts column in a dataset with line-deduplicated texts from another dataset
save_dataset_to_s3: save a merged HuggingFace dataset to disk and sync it to an S3 bucket
configure_pil_for_large_images: configure PIL to handle large and truncated images by setting MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS and LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES
